gloss: (formal/humble) presenting a gift to a superior

definitions.gloss: (formal/humble) presenting a gift to a superior; offering something to a person of higher status
definitions.explanation: (formal/humble) presenting a gift to a superior; offering something to a person of higher status

examples.japanese: ⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{進上|しんじょう}⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I humbly present this tea to you.

examples.japanese: ⟦{殿様|とのさま}→殿様：10455_tonosama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{名産品|めいさんひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{進上|しんじょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Local specialties were presented to the lord.

examples.japanese: {菓子折|かしおり}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{熨斗|のし}→熨斗：07133_noshi⟧{紙|がみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「{進上|しんじょう}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}かれていた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The gift wrapping paper on the box of sweets was inscribed with 'shinjo' (presented with respect).

notes:
A humble term for presenting something to a social superior, composed of {進|しん} (to advance/present) and ⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧ (upward/to a superior). Historically used when offering goods or gifts to nobility, feudal lords, or the emperor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {進上|しんじょう}⟦いたす→いたす：01314_itasu⟧ — to humbly present (humble verb form)
- {進上|しんじょう}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ — a presented gift
- {進上|しんじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to present to a superior

USAGE:
In modern Japanese, {進上|しんじょう} survives mainly on the ⟦{熨斗|のし}→熨斗：07133_noshi⟧{紙|がみ} (formal gift wrapping paper) used for traditional gift-giving. It appears as a printed label on gifts presented to superiors or on formal occasions. The word is otherwise archaic in everyday conversation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{献上|けんじょう}→献上：13528_kenjou⟧ — presenting to the emperor or royalty (even higher formality)
- ⟦{贈呈|ぞうてい}→贈呈：16752_zoutei⟧ — formal presentation of a gift or award
- ⟦{進呈|しんてい}→進呈：18249_shintei⟧ — presenting/giving (humble, but less formal than {進上|しんじょう})
